issues.description: [suggestion] Surface synced sleep data as a Sleep card on Dashboard/Progress. Problem: Health Connect sync already pulls sleep_minutes every day (health-connect.service.ts, POST /api/v1/health/sync -> health_sync.py) and the backend stores it, but nothing in the app ever reads it back -- no dashboard card, no Weekly Insights mention, no coaching-prompt use. Users grant sleep permission for a data point the app silently swallows and never shows them, which reads as broken/pointless once noticed. v1 scope: a Dashboard card (or Progress tab section) showing last-night sleep + 7-day avg/trend, sourced from the existing synced field -- no new sync work needed. Stretch: mention short-sleep nights in Weekly Insights copy. Effort: small-medium (FE-only for v1: one card + one query; backend already has the data).

issues.description: [suggestion] One-tap "Repeat meal" on the Nutrition diary — long-press or a small repeat-icon on any past meal card re-logs the same food(s)/quantities to today with one confirm tap, instead of requiring the CustomMealModal. Problem: athletes eat the same breakfast/post-workout shake most days but must reopen the manual-entry modal, hunt the food again via search or the buried "Recent meals" chip row (CustomMealModal.tsx:514-533), and resubmit every time — friction that discourages consistent logging (the exact behavior daily-completion/streak scoring depends on). Evidence: repo scan confirmed barcode scan, water tracker, and streak-freeze already exist, but no true repeat-log exists anywhere in src/pages/Nutrition.tsx or src/pages/_components/nutrition/ — the closest is the modal's prefill-only "Recent meals" row, which still requires opening the modal and resubmitting. Comparable trackers (MyFitnessPal "Copy meal", Cronometer "Copy from previous day") ship this as a core retention feature. v1 scope: add a repeat icon/swipe action on each meal-diary row (today or yesterday) that calls the existing add-meal/log endpoint with the same food_items + quantities, no new backend route needed; skip cross-day "copy whole day" for v1. Effort: ~0.5-1 day FE-only (new button + reuse existing log-meal service call).

issues.reviewReason: Root cause found and fix DEPLOYED to production (backend ab0ff39). The workout builder was saving each sequential day (Day 1/2/3/4) pinned to a calendar weekday, and 'Today's Workout' picked whichever day matched today's weekday — so taking a rest day let the calendar skip your next unfinished day (you did Day 1 + Day 2, rested, and it jumped to Day 4 Pull instead of Day 3 Push). New or rebuilt builder plans now advance by COMPLETION — finishing a day unlocks the next, a rest day repeats instead of skipping. WHY NOT MARKED FIXED: your CURRENT plan was saved before this fix and is still stored weekday-pinned, so the app will keep showing the wrong day until the plan is rebuilt. Fastest fix on your end: Activity -> Customize Workout -> Save (re-saves it under the corrected sequential engine). Right now, your correct next workout is Day 3 Push (the next unfinished day). I can also run a one-time migration to convert your existing plan in place — reply and I'll do it.
